final_decision.scientific_interpretation: C1 improved validation graph F1 and normal-run FPR, but the improvement did not transfer. On blind test, graph F1 decreased and normal false-positive rate increased substantially. The remaining failure is therefore not solved by a simple readout change and is more consistent with representation and scenario distribution mismatch.
